jp.t: 最強の威力者になってみせるわ
jp.tr: I'll show you. I'm going to become the strongest Aspirant.

en.t: The strongest Aspirant takes on the heaviest responsibilities. I am ready.

id.t: Aspirant terkuat mengemban tanggung jawab terberat. Aku siap untuk itu.
id.tr: The strongest Aspirant takes on the heaviest responsibilities. I am ready.

ar.t: أقوى المنقذون يتولى المهمات الأكبر، أنا مستعدة
ar.tr: The strongest Aspirant takes on the heaviest responsibilities. I am ready.

es.t: El Aspirante más fuerte asume las responsabilidades más pesadas. Estoy lista.
es.tr: The strongest Aspirant takes on the heaviest responsibilities. I am ready.

pt.t: O Aspirante mais forte assume as maiores responsabilidades. Estou pronta.
pt.tr: The strongest Aspirant takes on the heaviest responsibilities. I am ready.

tr.t: En güçlü Aspirant, en ağır sorumlulukları üstlenir. Ve ben buna hazırım.
tr.tr: The strongest Aspirant takes on the heaviest responsibilities. I am ready.

ru.t: Сильнейший Претендент несет тяжелейшую ответственность. Я готова к этому.
ru.tr: The strongest Aspirant takes on the heaviest responsibilities. I am ready.

jp.t: この世界の未来には、必ず勝利が待っている
jp.tr: Victory is certain to await the future of this world.

en.t: Victory is the only option for the future of our world.

id.t: Kemenangan adalah satu-satunya pilihan bagi masa depan dunia.
id.tr: Victory is the only option for the future of our world.

ar.t: لا تعرف رصاصاتي هدفا سوى النصر
ar.tr: Victory is the only option for the future of our world.

es.t: La victoria es la única opción para el futuro de nuestro mundo.
es.tr: Victory is the only option for the future of our world.

pt.t: O futuro do nosso mundo depende apenas da vitória
pt.tr: Victory is the only option for the future of our world.

tr.tr: Victory is the only option for the future of our world.

ru.t: Победа, единственное возможное будущее для нашего мира.
ru.tr: Victory is the only option for the future of our world.

jp.t: いちごジャムのドーナツに抗えるものなんていないわ、ロボットだって同じよ
jp.tr: Nothing can resist a strawberry-jam doughnut. Even robots are the same.

en.t: Who knew machines had a sweet tooth? (Chuckles) I did!

id.t: Siapa sangka robot juga suka yang manis-manis?
id.tr: Who knew machines had a sweet tooth? (Chuckles) I did!

ar.t: كلا يعشق الحلويات، حتى الألداء! هممم
ar.tr: Who knew machines had a sweet tooth? (Chuckles) I did!

es.t: ¿Quién diría que las máquinas tendrían debilidad por lo dulce? (Risitas) ¡Yo lo sabía!
es.tr: Who knew machines had a sweet tooth? (Chuckles) I did!

pt.t: Quem poderia imaginar que máquinas gostavam de doces? (Risos) Euzinha!
pt.tr: Who knew machines had a sweet tooth? (Chuckles) I did!

tr.t: Tatlı seven robot mu olur ya? İlahi!
tr.tr: Who knew machines had a sweet tooth? (Chuckles) I did!

ru.t: Кто знал, что роботы, сладкоежки? Я!
ru.tr: Who knew machines had a sweet tooth? (Chuckles) I did!

jp.t: 全部壊すんじゃなくて、鬱陶しいものだけ壊しちゃうってのは
jp.tr: Instead of destroying everything, how about only destroying the annoying stuff?

en.t: Instead of destroying everything, how about just the annoying stuff?

id.t: Daripada semuanya dihancurkan, gimana kalau yang menyebalkan saja?
id.tr: Instead of destroying everything, how about just the annoying stuff?

ar.t: التدمير الشامل مبالغ فيه.. فلنكتف بما يزعجنا فحسب
ar.tr: Instead of destroying everything, how about just the annoying stuff?

es.t: En lugar de destruirlo todo, ¿qué tal si destruimos solo las cosas molestas?
es.tr: Instead of destroying everything, how about just the annoying stuff?

pt.t: Em vez de destruir tudo, que tal acabar só com o que incomoda?
pt.tr: Instead of destroying everything, how about just the annoying stuff?

tr.t: Her şeyi yakıp yıkmak yerine, sadece can sıkan şeyleri yok etsek ya?
tr.tr: Instead of destroying everything, how about just the annoying stuff?

ru.t: Может, не будем уничтожать все подряд, а избавимся только от раздражителей?
ru.tr: Instead of destroying everything, how about just the annoying stuff?

jp.t: 私の制服どう、自分でアレンジしたのよ
jp.tr: How do you like my uniform? I customized it myself.

en.t: It took me ages to perfect my battle suit. Stunning, right?

id.t: Butuh waktu yang lama bagiku untuk menyempurnakan pakaian perangku. Menakjubkan, bukan?
id.tr: It took me ages to perfect my battle suit. Stunning, right?

ar.t: استغرق الأمر مني وقتاً طويلاً لإتقان بدلة القتال هذه. مذهل.
ar.tr: It took me ages to perfect my battle suit. Stunning, right?

es.t: Me tomó años perfeccionar mi traje de batalla. Impresionante.
es.tr: It took me ages to perfect my battle suit. Stunning, right?

pt.t: Levei séculos pra aperfeiçoar meu traje de batalha. Impressionante, não acha?
pt.tr: It took me ages to perfect my battle suit. Stunning, right?

tr.t: Savaş kıyafetimi mükemmelleştirmem yıllarımı aldı. Nasıl ama, yakıyor değil mi?
tr.tr: It took me ages to perfect my battle suit. Stunning, right?

ru.t: Мне понадобилась вечность, чтобы довести костюм до идеала. Правда клевый?
ru.tr: It took me ages to perfect my battle suit. Stunning, right?

jp.t: 失くした仲間のことを考えると、いつも誤作動が発生します、でもこれは直したくありません
jp.tr: Whenever I think about the friends I lost, a malfunction always occurs. But I don't want to fix this.

en.t: Malfunction occurs every time I think of my lost friends, but I don't want to fix it.

id.t: Malfungsi selalu terjadi jika aku memikirkan temanku yang hilang, tapi aku tidak mau memperbaikinya.
id.tr: Malfunction occurs every time I think of my lost friends, but I don't want to fix it.

ar.t: يتعطل نظامي حين أفكر بأصدقائي الذين فقدتهم
ar.tr: Malfunction occurs every time I think of my lost friends, but I don't want to fix it.

es.t: El mal funcionamiento ocurre cada vez que pienso en mis amigos perdidos, pero no quiero arreglarlo.
es.tr: Malfunction occurs every time I think of my lost friends, but I don't want to fix it.

pt.t: Esse coração mecânico também dói quando perde um amigo, mas eu não quero consertar.
pt.tr: Malfunction occurs every time I think of my lost friends, but I don't want to fix it.

tr.t: Ne zaman kaybettiğim dostlarımı düşünsem hata alıyorum, ve - ben bunu düzeltmek istemiyorum.
tr.tr: Malfunction occurs every time I think of my lost friends, but I don't want to fix it.

ru.t: Когда я думаю о друзьях, которых потеряла, происходит сбой. Но я не хочу его исправлять.
ru.tr: Malfunction occurs every time I think of my lost friends, but I don't want to fix it.

jp.t: 私はもう大人だよ、子供扱いしないで
jp.tr: I'm already a grown-up. Don't treat me like a kid.

en.t: Hey, don't look down on me! This is the head of the science department at Selrick Academy you're talking to!

id.t: Hei, jangan remehkan aku! Aku ini kepala departemen sains di Akademi Selrick!
id.tr: Hey, don't look down on me! This is the head of the science department at Selrick Academy you're talking to!

ar.t: من قال أنني صغيرة على القتال؟ قل ذلك في وجهي وستندم
ar.tr: Hey, don't look down on me! This is the head of the science department at Selrick Academy you're talking to!

es.t: ¡Oye, no me menosprecies! ¡Estás hablando con la jefa del departamento de ciencias de la Academia Selrik!
es.tr: Hey, don't look down on me! This is the head of the science department at Selrick Academy you're talking to!

pt.t: Ei, não me subestime! Você tá falando com a chefe do centro de pesquisas da Academia Selrick!
pt.tr: Hey, don't look down on me! This is the head of the science department at Selrick Academy you're talking to!

tr.t: Hey, beni küçümseme! Karşında Selrick Akademisi'nin bilim bölümü başkanı var!
tr.tr: Hey, don't look down on me! This is the head of the science department at Selrick Academy you're talking to!

ru.t: Эй, не стоит меня недооценивать! Перед тобой глава научного отделения академии Селрика!
ru.tr: Hey, don't look down on me! This is the head of the science department at Selrick Academy you're talking to!

jp.t: 信念の声が響く限り、私は闇に抗おう
jp.tr: As long as the Aspirant voice echoes, I will resist the darkness.

en.t: When you lose yourself in the darkness, hope always shines through.

id.t: Saat dirimu hanyut ke dalam kegelapan, harapan akan menyinari jalanmu.
id.tr: When you lose yourself in the darkness, hope always shines through.

ar.t: حتى تهاويت في جوف العتمة، سترشدك شعلة النور التي لا تفتأ أن تخترق الظلام
ar.tr: When you lose yourself in the darkness, hope always shines through.

es.t: Cuando te pierdes en la oscuridad, la esperanza siempre brilla.
es.tr: When you lose yourself in the darkness, hope always shines through.

pt.t: Quando você se perde na escuridão, a luz sempre te encontra.
pt.tr: When you lose yourself in the darkness, hope always shines through.

tr.t: Her şey sona ermiş gibi görünse de umut mutlaka bir yol bulur.
tr.tr: When you lose yourself in the darkness, hope always shines through.

ru.t: Когда теряешься во тьме, обязательно найдется лучик надежды.
ru.tr: When you lose yourself in the darkness, hope always shines through.

jp.t: 私を拒み、逆らうがいい、最後には、等しく屈服することになるがな
jp.tr: Reject me, defy me if you like. In the end, you will all submit alike.

en.t: You can reject me, you can defy me, but in the end, you will submit all the same.

id.t: Menolakku, menentangku ... bebas saja! Kau akan tunduk juga pada akhirnya.
id.tr: You can reject me, you can defy me, but in the end, you will submit all the same.

ar.t: لك أن تتحديني، ولك أن تتمردي، لكنك في النهاية ستنصاعين رغماً عنك
ar.tr: You can reject me, you can defy me, but in the end, you will submit all the same.

es.t: Puedes rechazarme, puedes desafiarme, pero al final te someterás de todos modos.
es.tr: You can reject me, you can defy me, but in the end, you will submit all the same.

pt.t: Resista o quanto quiser... até perceber que a submissão é inevitável.
pt.tr: You can reject me, you can defy me, but in the end, you will submit all the same.

tr.t: Bana isyan da etseniz, karşı da gelseniz günün sonunda hepiniz biat edeceksiniz.
tr.tr: You can reject me, you can defy me, but in the end, you will submit all the same.

ru.t: Можешь отвергать меня, можешь бросать мне вызов, но в итоге все равно покоришься.
ru.tr: You can reject me, you can defy me, but in the end, you will submit all the same.
